title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Premium Remittances by the Cover Holder
content:
Under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` a cover holder can pay the premium of its own cover while speaking with the desk. This reference covers what such a payment amounts to and how it is made.

## Paying the premium in full

A cover holder that clears, in person and in one payment, the whole premium of a cover already bound pays exactly the premium balance owed on that cover. The rule reaches every premium paid after binding. Payments of the prepaid kind, owed ahead of binding by a cash-in-advance holder whose tier makes prepayment compulsory, are not what this section addresses.

## Conditions on any remittance

- A remittance settles premium standing on the cover's account, and its amount can never exceed the unpaid premium, the premium due, that the cover's account shows.
- The holder's remittance reference goes on record character for character as the holder gives it.
- One reference is recorded on a cover no more than once.

## Capability of the tool

`pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f` lets a cover holder settle, there and then, premium owed on a cover it holds, drawing on its own account and quoting its own remittance reference. A call enters one premium payment, dated today and carrying that reference, in the cover's premium and settlement record, and brings the cover's unpaid premium down by the sum paid.

## Invocation

The tool is the customer's to use. After the agent unlocks it and hands it across, the customer themselves runs it to make the payment.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cover_id` | the cover whose premium is being paid, as the desk passes it on from the cover lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the premium paid | US dollars, above zero, two decimals; kept rounded to the cent |
| `payment_reference` | the holder's own remittance reference for this payment | reproduced exactly as the holder gives it: every letter, digit and hyphen kept, case preserved, nothing translated, tidied, shortened, added or left out |

## Return

A successful call returns `status` "paid", `payment_event_id` (the reference of the new payment entry), `cover_id`, `amount_usd` as booked, `payment_reference` as recorded, and `premium_due_usd`, the premium still unpaid on the cover afterwards, in US dollars to two decimals.
